outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high fidelity desktop educational interaction design concept, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Design a compelling middle-school AI model training experiment bench. Students operate a real simulated experiment, collect observations, and train a simple prediction model. Make the relationships immediately comprehensible and the controls inviting to touch. This is a believable interactive website screen, not an ad or a photo of a console.

Scene/style: a first person shallow overhead view of a compact contemporary laboratory workbench, precise translucent acrylic, matte ivory, warm wood edge, graphite controls, natural daylight. Sophisticated, approachable, quietly tactile. No cute characters, no dark futuristic HUD. Crisp legible Simplified Chinese UI integrated with the equipment, generous spacing, no ornate bolts or unrelated props. Make the real observation scene occupy the upper half of the screen, model training occupy the lower half.

Composition and semantics:
Top slim product header: “NOVA 奇点” at left, “第五章 · 模型怎样学会” central. Below, a large frontal observation window with a silver miniature cart on a horizontal measurement rail, warm amber physical measurement marker at the cart, and a BLUE transparent prediction marker separated from the cart. The model controls do not alter the real cart. Label the two markers “实测” and “预测”. An unobtrusive time scrubber belongs to this window and reads “时刻 2 秒”. Track marks run left to right; no floating trees or scenery.
Lower left small sample holder titled “测量记录”. Three large cards in neat slots showing ONLY these observation pairs: “1 秒 / 3 厘米”, “2 秒 / 5 厘米”, “3 秒 / 7 厘米”. Highlight the second card as current focus. Adjacent tactile button “记录位置”. These cards are the data available to training, not cartridges with model weights.
Lower middle wide transparent model module labelled “当前模型”. A left to right visible calculation path labelled “时间” → “× w” → “+ b” → “预测位置”. Two pleasant large parameter dials below, labels “变化幅度 w” and “整体偏移 b”, both numeric readouts 1.00. A clear narrow separation of the amber real measurement from blue predicted output; do not make real measurements depend on the dials.
Lower right a restrained primary control “学习一步”, a smaller action “展开过程”, and “第 0 轮”. A compact CLOSED envelope tray labelled “新时刻检验”; no unknown sample answers exposed.
Along bottom, a short coherent phase strip “读取记录 → 计算误差 → 调整参数 → 再次预测”, not 4 unrelated dashboards.
Make the same actual cart, the training records, the model, and the changed prediction feel like one linked interaction. Use blue for model outputs and amber for observed truth. Visual emphasis on the large cart observation window and the accessible learning action. Do not fill with charts, scores, missions, schedules, chatbot, photo thumbnails, badges, or invented values. Render Chinese exactly, few words, high quality finished interface concept.
